summary: Nora can open a specific link again — web_fetch is back, reading a page's content via Tavily instead of the retired SSRF-exposed fetcher.
details: When someone pastes a link and asks about it, or a web_search snippet isn't enough, she can now read the actual page.
Reuses the same Tavily key and [search] gate as web_search — off until an operator enables it, and both answer unavailable together if the key is missing.
limitations: Budgeted at 2 calls per turn, tighter than web_search's 4 — a page is heavier than a snippet.
